trends: AI-specific capabilities such as analytics platforms show significant variance in maturity across business domains.
Foundational data capabilities remain the weakest area, with many processes scoring in the 0–1 maturity range.
Deployment-related dimensions (use cases and value created) display moderate maturity but are unevenly distributed.
Strategic and governance capabilities show mid-level maturity, suggesting partial institutionalization of AI efforts.

Certain highlighted domains—procurement, marketing, content creation, and HR—demonstrate pockets of high maturity, tied to concrete AI-enabled use cases such as RPA efficiency, next-product recommendations, content scaling, and HR skills mapping.
